import asyncio, json
from spotify_mcp.server import main
from spotify_mcp.client import SpotifyClient
from spotify_mcp.tools.playlists import fetch_all_playlist_items
from spotify_mcp.tools.dance_mix import _split_old_new, _build_3_3_sequence

async def test\(\):
    async with SpotifyClient\(\) as sp:
        items_a = await fetch_all_playlist_items\(sp, '63QGqp4Kz3tOilxVMwnefI'\)
        items_b = await fetch_all_playlist_items\(sp, '0sYrK1a8Q2RRvlNnA47KPj'\)
        print\(f'Bachata: {len\(items_a\)} tracks, Kizomba: {len\(items_b\)} tracks'\)

        old_a, new_a = _split_old_new\(items_a\)
        old_b, new_b = _split_old_new\(items_b\)
        sequence = _build_3_3_sequence\(old_a, new_a, old_b, new_b, block_size=3\)
        sequence = sequence[:12]
        track_uris = [item['track_uri'] for item in sequence if item.get\('track_uri'\)]

        for i, item in enumerate\(sequence\):
            print\(f'  {i+1}. [{item.get\(\\"_source\\"\)}] {item.get\(\\"track_name\\"\)} - {item.get\(\\"artists\\"\)}'\)

        playlist_data = await sp.post\('me/playlists', json={
            'name': 'Smer77 - Test',
            'description': 'Dance mix: 3-3 pattern \(bachata/kizomba\)',
            'public': False,
        }\)
        new_id = playlist_data['id']
        url = playlist_data.get\('external_urls', {}\).get\('spotify'\)
        print\(f'\\nPlaylist created: {url}'\)

        await sp.post\(f'playlists/{new_id}/items', json={'uris': track_uris}\)
        print\(f'Added {len\(track_uris\)} tracks!'\)

asyncio.run\(test\(\)\)
" 2>&1)
